config.entry: One entry per confirmed 15m Stoch5/3/3 arrow. Require a directional wick containing a same-week Fib price within two 15m bars before/after the arrow. Enter at the first close at which both facts are known. Prefer the nearest already-known touch when several are available at the arrow close. No H1 watch gate.
config.levels: Both lo+r*(hi-lo) and hi-r*(hi-lo), deduplicate midpoint. Use the current Monday range known BEFORE each touch candle opens; Monday develops, Tuesday-Sunday freeze. First Monday candle has no new-week level. Never back-project final Monday extrema.
config.wick: Long: low <= level <= min(open,close); short: max(open,close) <= level <= high. Require a nonzero directional wick. Zero extra price tolerance.
config.stops: Latest three completed 15m extrema at entry, equivalent to nine complete 5m bars; entry-price buffer 0.1/0.2 percent; round outward to tick.
config.exits: Native fixed 2/3/5/10R target and initial stop, independent positions, no trailing/breakeven/opposite exit. Force closure at each chronological segment boundary. Retain native O-H-L-C results and stop-first same-bar sensitivity.
config.controls: Same BTC/side/UTC week/time segment/causal ATR14 bucket, 15m-close random entry, without replacement within each family/side/stratum; exclude all real arrow and combined entry bars. Same stop/target/cost. Preserve unmatched events and report paired subsets separately.
config.baseline: Confirmed 15m arrows without the location gate, under the same eight exits and matched controls. It also differs in entry timing when a combined event waits for a later touch.
config.selection: Maximize cumulative net original-risk R on the first year, using stop-first sensitivity; second year evaluates that frozen choice. All-history best is descriptive. Ratios/directions/developing Mondays are descriptive strata, not additional fitted filters.
config.not_applicable: No fitted model or score: AUC and top-decile ranking metrics do not apply. Arrow-only and matched random controls provide the null comparisons.
